text: yearly: Heb. from year to year
a worthy portion: Or, a double portion
when she went up: Or, from the time that she, etc: Heb. from her going up | in bitterness of soul: Heb. bitter of soul
a man child: Heb. seed of men
continued praying: Heb. multiplied to pray
of a sorrowful spirit: Heb. hard of spirit
time was come about: Heb. revelation of days | Samuel: That is, asked of God
lent him to the LORD: Or, returned him, whom I have obtained by petition to the LORD | he shall be lent to the LORD: Or, he whom I have obtained by petiotion, shall be returned
